legend: Lolek loves to play the lottery and to cheat. And recently he found a loophole in the lottery ticket submission system! There is a delay between announcement of the winning numbers and the end of ticket submission.

The rules of the lottery are simple as always. The participant buys a lottery ticket on which n$$$n$$$ positive integers are written. Then on a certain day, n$$$n$$$ positive integers are announced: the winning numbers. All participants will see them as an array of integers b$$$b$$$. Also, the prizes are announced in advance: if the i$$$i$$$-th element of the participant's ticket matches the i$$$i$$$-th element of the winning ticket, the participant receives ci$$$c_i$$$ coins.

Lolek decided to use the loophole in the system for his enrichment. He has an official template for a lottery ticket, which is an array a$$$a$$$ of size n$$$n$$$ filled with ones. Lolek also has a device for changing the digits on the ticket.

Unfortunately, the device is homemade, and works as follows. Lolek can choose two integers i$$$i$$$ (1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$) and z$$$z$$$ (z>0$$$z  \gt  0$$$) and increase ai$$$a_i$$$ by ⌊aiz⌋$$$\left\lfloor \frac{a_i}{z} \right\rfloor$$$ (the quotient of dividing ai$$$a_i$$$ by z$$$z$$$, rounded down). Lolek can choose the same i$$$i$$$ for operations as many times as he wants.
But this process is not fast, and the time for the loophole is limited. In total, Lolek will be able to perform no more than k$$$k$$$ operations. Therefore, he asked you to maximize his winnings.
Your task is to determine the maximum number of coins that Lolek can receive by performing no more than k$$$k$$$ operations.
input: The first line contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤103$$$1 \leq n \leq 10^3$$$): the number of integers on the lottery ticket.
The second line contains a single integer k$$$k$$$ (0≤k≤106$$$0 \leq k \leq 10^6$$$): the maximum number of operations.
The third line contains n$$$n$$$ integers bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤bi≤103$$$1 \leq b_i \leq 10^3$$$): the winning lottery ticket.
The fourth line contains n$$$n$$$ integers ci$$$c_i$$$ (0≤ci≤106$$$0 \leq c_i \leq 10^6$$$): the number of coins received if the numbers match.
output: A single integer: the maximum number of coins that can be obtained by performing no more than k$$$k$$$ operations.

legend.ai: Lolek 喜欢买彩票，也喜欢作弊。最近，他在彩票提交系统中发现了一个漏洞！中奖号码公布与彩票提交截止之间存在一段延迟。
彩票规则一如既往地简单。参与者购买一张彩票，上面写有 n$$$n$$$ 个正整数。随后在某一天，会公布 n$$$n$$$ 个正整数作为中奖号码。所有参与者都会看到一个由整数构成的数组 b$$$b$$$。此外，奖金也会提前公布：如果参与者的彩票中第 i$$$i$$$ 个元素与中奖彩票中的第 i$$$i$$$ 个元素相同，参与者就能获得 ci$$$c_i$$$ 枚硬币。
Lolek 决定利用这个系统漏洞来发财。他有一张彩票的官方模板，这是一个大小为 n$$$n$$$、且所有元素都为 1 的数组 a$$$a$$$。Lolek 还有一个可以修改彩票上数字的装置。

遗憾的是，这个装置是自制的，其工作方式如下。Lolek 可以选择两个整数 i$$$i$$$(1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$)和 z$$$z$$$(z>0$$$z  \gt  0$$$)，然后将 ai$$$a_i$$$ 增加 ⌊aiz⌋$$$\left\lfloor \frac{a_i}{z} \right\rfloor$$$(即将 ai$$$a_i$$$ 除以 z$$$z$$$ 所得的商向下取整)。Lolek 可以任意多次选择同一个 i$$$i$$$ 进行操作。
但是，这个过程并不快，而利用漏洞的时间是有限的。总共而言，Lolek 最多只能执行 k$$$k$$$ 次操作。因此，他请你最大化自己获得的奖金。
你的任务是确定 Lolek 至多执行 k$$$k$$$ 次操作时能够获得的最大硬币数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤103$$$1 \leq n \leq 10^3$$$)：彩票上整数的个数。
第二行包含一个整数 k$$$k$$$(0≤k≤106$$$0 \leq k \leq 10^6$$$)：操作次数的最大值。
第三行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 bi$$$b_i$$$(1≤bi≤103$$$1 \leq b_i \leq 10^3$$$)：中奖的彩票。
第四行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 ci$$$c_i$$$(0≤ci≤106$$$0 \leq c_i \leq 10^6$$$)：数字匹配时获得的硬币数量。

output.ai: 一个整数：至多进行 k$$$k$$$ 次操作可以获得的最大硬币数。
